settlement.markCadence: checked every 5 minutes; published when the index moves, and at least every 20 minutes (Kuru's claim deposits and withdrawals need a price no more than 30 minutes old; the observed age is shown next to the mark)

source.name: Composite H100 SXM on-demand price (median of public sources)
source.summary: The median of four public H100 SXM, 1-GPU, on-demand prices fetched by a Chainlink CRE workflow: Akash Console's public price API, RunPod, Verda and Shadeform's median across its SXM clouds. A reading is used only if at least 3 of the 4 sources return a valid price, and any failed source is recorded in the evidence. With an even number of valid sources the median is the mean of the two middle values.

sanityBand.name: GetDeploying weekly H100 median
sanityBand.note: Median of 41 providers. A published reference for the level, not used for settlement.

components.name: Akash Console (public API)
components.detail: Derived from on-chain bids, trailing average
components.rule: Akash Console's public GPU price endpoint, built from on-chain marketplace bids. NVIDIA H100, 80Gi, SXM5: the weighted-average price across providers, with at least 2 providers required. It is a 14 to 31 day trailing average, so it moves more slowly than a spot quote.
components.why: A decentralised GPU market. The value comes from Akash Console's public API, which derives it from on-chain bids; the workflow does not read the chain directly.

components.name: RunPod
components.rule: Public GraphQL price list. NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, 1 GPU: the lowest on-demand (non-interruptible) price.
components.why: A large on-demand GPU cloud that publishes its price without a login.

components.name: Verda
components.rule: Public instance-type list. 1x H100 SXM5 80GB: the cheapest matching instance, in USD per hour.
components.why: An independent GPU cloud with public, machine-readable instance pricing.

components.name: Shadeform
components.detail: Median of 4 SXM clouds, Verda excluded
components.rule: Public marketplace API across clouds. H100 SXM5, 1 GPU: the cheapest listing per cloud, then the median across at least 4 clouds, with Verda excluded so it is not counted twice.
components.why: An aggregator over many clouds, so one provider's pricing quirks are diluted.
